local function SCRIPT_76()
local script = UI["76"]
	local button = script.Parent
	local activeColor = Color3.fromRGB(55, 255, 0)
	local inactiveColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	
	local function createESPBox(character)
		local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		if not rootPart then
			warn("HumanoidRootPart bulunamadı:", character.Name)
			return
		end
	
		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name = "ESPBox"
		billboard.Adornee = rootPart
		billboard.Size = UDim2.new(4, 0, 6, 0)
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboard.Enabled = button.BackgroundColor3 == activeColor
		billboard.Parent = rootPart
	
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
			frame.Name = "Line" .. i
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.04, 0)
			frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
			frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			frame.Parent = billboard
	
			if i == 1 then
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			elseif i == 2 then
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1)
			elseif i == 3 then
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 1, 0)
			elseif i == 4 then
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -1, 0, 0)
				frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 1, 0)
			end
		end
	
		return billboard
	end
	
	local function updateESPBoxColor(character)
		local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not rootPart then return end
	
		local billboard = rootPart:FindFirstChild("ESPBox")
		if billboard then
			local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
			if player then
				for _, frame in pairs(billboard:GetChildren()) do
					if frame:IsA("Frame") then
						frame.BackgroundColor3 = player.Team and player.Team.TeamColor.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function setupESPForPlayer(player)
		if player == game.Players.LocalPlayer then
			return
		end
	
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			print("Karakter yüklendi:", player.Name)
			character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			local billboard = createESPBox(character)
			if billboard then
				updateESPBoxColor(character)
			end
		end)
	
		if player.Character then
			local character = player.Character
			character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			local billboard = createESPBox(character)
			if billboard then
				updateESPBoxColor(character)
			end
		end
	
		player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
			if player.Character then
				updateESPBoxColor(player.Character)
			end
		end)
	end
	
	local function setupESPForAllPlayers()
		for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
			setupESPForPlayer(player)
		end
	end
	
	game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupESPForPlayer)
	
	game.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			local rootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if rootPart:FindFirstChild("ESPBox") then
				rootPart:FindFirstChild("ESPBox"):Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
	
	local function onButtonColorChanged()
		local isActive = button.BackgroundColor3 == activeColor
		for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player == game.Players.LocalPlayer then
				continue
			end
	
			if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local rootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local billboard = rootPart:FindFirstChild("ESPBox")
				if billboard then
					billboard.Enabled = isActive
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	setupESPForAllPlayers()
	
	button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(onButtonColorChanged)

local function SCRIPT_7e()
local script = UI["7e"]
	local textButton = script.Parent
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	
	local minSize = 3
	local maxSize = 4
	
	local function createNameTag(player)
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("Head") then return end
		local head = character.Head
	
		if head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") then
			head.NameTag:Destroy()
		end
	
		local billboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboardGui.Name = "NameTag"
		billboardGui.Adornee = head
		billboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
		billboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		billboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboardGui.Enabled = textButton.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(55, 255, 0)
	
		local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		textLabel.Parent = billboardGui
		textLabel.Text = player.Name
		textLabel.TextColor3 = player.TeamColor.Color
		textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		textLabel.TextScaled = true
		textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	
		billboardGui.Parent = head
	end
	
	local function adjustNameTagSizes()
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player == Players.LocalPlayer then continue end
	
			local character = player.Character
			if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") and character.Head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") then
				local head = character.Head
				local billboardGui = head.NameTag
				local distance = (camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
	
				local clampedSize = math.clamp((distance / 20), minSize, maxSize)
				billboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, clampedSize * 20, 0, clampedSize * 5)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function checkButtonColor()
		local isVisible = textButton.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(55, 255, 0)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") and character.Head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") then
				character.Head.NameTag.Enabled = isVisible
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function monitorPlayer(player)
		local function onCharacterAdded(character)
			character:WaitForChild("Head")
			wait(1)
			createNameTag(player)
			checkButtonColor()
		end
	
		if player.Character then
			onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
		end
	
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
	end
	
	local function updateNameTags()
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= Players.LocalPlayer then
				monitorPlayer(player)
			end
		end
	end
	
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(monitorPlayer)
	
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") and character.Head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") then
			character.Head.NameTag:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	
	textButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(checkButtonColor)
	
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(adjustNameTagSizes)
	
	updateNameTags()
	checkButtonColor()
	
end

	local dragging = false

	local function onInputBegan(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = guiObject.Position

				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	
	local function onInputChanged(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			local newPos = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
			guiObject.Position = newPos
		end
	end
	
	guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged)
	
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	end)

		local f = h * 6 - i

		local q = v * (1 - f * s)

		i = i % 6
